Sara — thanks for the clear notes and the redlines. High level answers so you have them while we pull in legal/privacy:

- EU-only routing: yes, we can do a routing/region preference at the tenant level. For hosted customers this is an order-form option; for tighter isolation we can offer a Dedicated pool or Private deployment. There is a small recurring premium for dedicated resources.
- Role mapping: we accept processor role in the DPA. We typically add language clarifying any ancillary services where Redwood acts under processor instructions only.
- SCCs: Redwood signs the controller->processor module of the EU SCCs. We also maintain subprocessors list and notify customers 30 days before new subprocessors are onboarded.
- TIA/TIA-addendum: we have a standard Transfer Impact Addendum that summarizes legal and technical controls for transfers; I'll attach a current draft and loop Legal & Privacy to confirm.

Diego — reviewed. High-level summary and recommended next steps below. I attached a redlined DPA (Redwood_DPA_draft_20260916.pdf) with inline comments.

Summary / recommended language:
- Role mapping: we should accept controller/processor characterization but add explicit language: "Redwood acts solely as Processor with respect to Customer Personal Data and will not determine purposes and means of processing except as expressly provided in the Order Form." Add a narrow carve-out for aggregated telemetry: "Aggregated, de-identified metrics are outside the scope of this DPA."
- SCCs: we can sign the controller->processor module. Add a clause referencing downstream subprocessors and mapping of SCCs in the subprocessor agreements (language provided in redline ¶7.4).
- TIA: shareable as a Transfer Impact Addendum. Suggest sharing a redacted copy that lists non-sensitive mitigations (encryption at rest/in transit, contractual commitments, subprocessors list reference, location controls) and offer to run a scoped security review under an NDA for deeper requests.
- Subprocessor notifications: propose 30-day notice plus emergency onboarding clause (with immediate notice and post-facto approval if needed for security incident mitigation).
- Order Form / EU-only: recommend an Order Form addendum checkbox that enumerates routing options (hosted EU, dedicated EU, private). For hosted EU, include a standard 8-12% price uplift in the redline. For Dedicated/Private, refer to Dedicated pricing schedule.
- Audit/Access: suggest limited audit rights scoped to SSAE/SOC reports and third-party penetration test summaries rather than full production access. Offer a quarterly evidence package for healthcare customers.

Action items for Diego / Solutions:
- Confirm whether Hosted EU routing is available as a self-service toggle (Engineering ops).
- Confirm estimated price delta for Hosted EU routing vs Dedicated pool (Monica).
- Prepare a redacted TIA and share via secure link; Legal will approve redactions.

Attaching the redline and suggested language snippets. If that looks good I'll prep a short MSA amendment + DPA with the documented options and a proposed timeline. Recommend DocuSign flow with the DPA attached to the MSA.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
